dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.platformui.getWorkbench>
<!description: Replace AbstractUIPlugin.getWorkbench() with PlatformUI.getWorkbench().
This is generally preferred as PlatformUI provides a more direct and static way to access the workbench, avoiding the need to retrieve a plugin instance first.>
<!severity: HINT>

$plugin.getWorkbench() :: instanceof($plugin, "org.eclipse.ui.plugin.AbstractUIPlugin")
=> org.eclipse.ui.PlatformUI.getWorkbench()
;;
summary: Replaces calls to `getWorkbench()` on instances of `AbstractUIPlugin` (or its subclasses) with the static call `PlatformUI.getWorkbench()`.
